QuestInfo.name: Giants of the Cold Flame
QuestInfo.0: Ask what Grendel the Really Old has for you.
QuestInfo.1: Grendel the Really Old brought back a #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern that can absorb the power of light. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to move to #m100040300# and defeat #b50 Flaming Mixed Golems#k. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k again to return.
QuestInfo.2: You added the Cold Flames to the Vampiric Lantern after defeating the Flaming Mixed Golems.

0.0: This little baby is called a Vampiric Lantern. It sucks up light--any kind of light--and stores it for later.\r\n#L0##bWhat of it?#l\n#k
0.2: Take this and hunt #b50 Flaming Mixed Golems#k at Golem's Temple 3rd floor. The cold flame is referring to those golems, I'm sure of it.

yes.0: #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to teleport to the Flaming Mixed Golems. Double-click on it to return when you're done.

no.0: If you don't believe me, then leave!

0.1: I'll tell you, but first you must promise to leave Ellinia when we're done here.\r\n#L0##bTrust me, I have no intention of staying in this backwoods town.#l\n#k

mob.0: Don't just hang around here. You have golems to hunt, and the less time you spend in my library the better!
